The '''Pentarchy of Ledostrov''' was a five-noble regime that took power during the 1942 succession crisis in the [[Duchy of Ledostrov]].

== Formation ==

After the [[Count of Litwaldov]] died childless, the [[Duma of Ledostrov]] could not reach the required two-thirds majority to elect a duke. A faction of five nobles led by [[Uzryta of Ledostrov]] bribed the military leadership, stormed the Duma, and removed opponents through imprisonment or execution.

== Rule ==

The Pentarchy governed through a weakened Duma and forced through unpopular laws. It accelerated industrialization but did little to improve ordinary living conditions. Uzryta's refusal to permit a new ducal election made the regime appear illegitimate to many Ledostrov citizens.

== Opposition And Fall ==

Mass strikes, protests, and army dissent grew over roughly the following decade. When the [[Southern Defense Force of Ledostrov]] refused orders and moved toward [[Novoanov]] under [[Reznikoff of Ledostrov]], the regime collapsed. Remaining Pentarchs were executed after Reznikoff took power.
